messages:
Cass: Quick heads-up — noticed drop in conversions after last search launch. attribution looks wrong when users come back via social. Anyone else see this? :thinking_face:
Jules: Yep saw it in GA4, last-click shows 'social' but session source is search. UTMs inconsistent between ad platforms.
Noah: Which params? I can patch tracking rules in the router.
Cass: Main offenders: missing utm_campaign + inconsistent utm_source values. Also ad_id vs gclid mismatch. Example we need:
```
utm_source=google|facebook
utm_medium=cpc
utm_campaign=prod-launch-apr2026
utm_content=creative-1
```
Jules: sending updated UTM table in the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FakeLink (tab: UTM mapping)
Priya: can we standardize source labels so inbound lead routing picks up 'search-paid' and 'social-paid'? current rules only look for 'google' and 'facebook'
Noah: I'll update the router regex to map google|bing -> search-paid and facebook|x|instagram -> social-paid. Will push config in 20m.
DesignBot: @Priya dropping revised 1200x628 and 1080x1080 assets in Drive in case we need content swaps. :white_check_mark:
Cass: Also want to A/B the CTA copy — 'Try Redwood Free' vs 'Start Serving Now'. Can we run creative swap for next 48h and monitor conv rate? @Jules
Jules: Yep setting up 50/50 creative split in SA360 and FB, will add conv metric to the dashboard. Linking after setup.
ads-ops: Deploy note — updated UTM mapping and router rules will trigger a short attribution reprocess. Expect 30m of retroactive session stitching.
Priya: perfect. once Noah confirms router push, I'll update inbound slack alerts to include source normalized field.
Cass: Thanks team. small checklist:
- Noah: router regex pushed
- Jules: creative split + dashboard
- Priya: slack alerts + lead routing test
- Design: assets in drive
Callout: monitor leads from organic vs paid closely for 24h. :eyes:
